relations: Expanding fireball causes its irregular upper edge to rise and broaden into a rounded dome.
Dense smoke at the base is continuously reshaped and re-illuminated by the growing central glow.
Increasing luminous wash brightens the foreground and reduces the contrast of the water tower silhouette.
Fixed camera perspective keeps the sloping rock berm and thin fence poles in static positions.
caption: The video captures a fixed fisheye night-vision view of an outdoor site where a large incandescent fireball is already expanding. A lattice water tower stands at left-center, while a sloping rock berm and a flat foreground with thin poles and a fence line remain fixed in view. The bright white-yellow core occupies the center and right, its irregular upper edge rising as the glowing mass broadens into a rounded dome. Dense smoke clouds billow around the base and left side, continuously reshaped and re-illuminated by the fireball behind them. Two bright linear trails arc upward near the tower and at the upper right, extending and fading as small specks scatter across the dark sky. The overall scene brightens as the glow washes over the foreground, making the tower silhouette less distinct against the luminous smoke. The rock pile and fence posts hold their positions throughout, confirming no camera pan, tilt, or zoom. The fireball still dominates the frame, with no visible collapse or dissipation.
